blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV may be presented as the House prosecution panel’s next witness in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Wednesday. However, presiding officer Francis Escudero advised against it. Trillanes, who was expected to testify on Duterte’s alleged acquisition of funds, was originally scheduled to testify after officials from the Anti–Money Laundering Council (AMLC) and various banks, but the House prosecution requested to move up his presentation to Wednesday.
